subject.title: fix(node): fail closed on invalid trusted-proxy CIDRs and warn on untrusted forwarding

question: Should malformed CRABBOX_TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS values intentionally stop the entire Node coordinator during upgrade, or should startup remain compatible while diagnostics expose the misconfiguration?
rationale: Both choices can preserve the proxy trust boundary, but unconditional failure can turn a bounded OAuth-login availability problem into complete coordinator downtime for an existing deployment.

options.title: Warn and remain untrusted
options.body: Keep the coordinator running, exclude invalid entries from all trust decisions, and emit a clear startup warning naming the bad entry.

options.title: Add opt-in strict mode
options.body: Preserve compatible startup by default and offer an explicit strict setting for operators who want malformed allowlists to be fatal.

options.title: Accept fatal validation
options.body: Approve process-fatal validation as an intentional compatibility break after fresh-install and upgrade behavior are demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Warn and remain untrusted
recommendation.body: Keep the coordinator running, exclude invalid entries from all trust decisions, and emit a clear startup warning naming the bad entry.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged history ties this person most directly to the OAuth source-admission and Node proxy-trust behavior.
